notes: hand-built (the terraced dome read as a stepped pyramid, and its peak sat mid-face where a cup is open). Hood = a shell sliced along X: each slice is an extruded quarter-superellipse band from the top edge at the door out to the lower lip at the projection, hollow underneath for the fingers; +Z = down the door, screws on z = 0. Crescent hood (top edge arcs up 6 mm, lip a half ellipse) with round screw lugs at the ends as in M406_0 (the photo puts the screws ~89 mm apart against the spec c2c 63.5 mm; ends follow the photo, length the spec)
